subject: force field combination for a protein-RNA complex

messages.author: Sruthi Sudhakar
messages.body:
Dear all,
I want to ask what is the best recommended force field combination for
protein-RNA complexes. I am particularly interested in the water model to
be used in this regard. We have been using ff14SB, OL3 and TIP3P for our
previous simulations. But I have read about the ff19SB and it being more
accurate with OPC. Kindly advise regarding the same.
Regards,
Sruthi
